about.title: Engineering Warmth Since 2002
about.intro: Founded in 2002, Jiuding Radiator is a professional manufacturer of steel panel radiators, steel column radiators, copper–aluminum composite radiators, designer radiators, and heated towel rails based in Tianjin, China. With over 20 years of experience, CE and UKCA certifications, and 42 national patents, we export to 30+ countries across Europe, the CIS, Central Asia, the Caucasus, the Middle East & North Africa, and South America — including the UK, Germany, France, Belgium, Spain, Poland, Romania, Sweden, Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Turkmenistan, Tajikistan, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Turkey, Algeria, Libya, Argentina, and Mongolia. We are a trusted OEM/ODM partner for distributors and project developers worldwide.

credentials.narrativeText: Tianjin Jiuding Yangguang HVAC Co., Ltd. — trading as Jiuding Radiator — manufactures steel panel and multi-column radiators under a documented, third-party-verified certification framework. CE conformity is established through 10 Declarations of Performance issued under EU Construction Products Regulation No. 305/2011 by HEATEST s.r.o. (Notified Body NB 2693, Czech Republic), covering both column and panel radiator ranges to EN 442-1:2014. For the UK market, independent thermal performance tests have been conducted by BSRIA Limited (Bracknell, UK) to BS EN 442-2:2014 — the same standard underlying CE conformity — providing third-party UK backing for seven column radiator models. Quality and environmental management systems are certified to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 by Xingyuan Certification Centre (CNAS-accredited, IAF member), valid through June 2027. REACH/SVHC compliance is confirmed by SGS test report No. TSNEC2000446701. All CE-certified products achieve reaction-to-fire class A1. Jiuding also holds a Russian market conformity certificate and has exhibited at ISH 2026 (Frankfurt) and MCE Expocomfort 2026 (Milan) as a registered new exhibitor.
credentials.ukConformityText: Jiuding does not hold a separately-issued UKCA certificate. UK market conformity is supported by BSRIA independent test reports (104719/1 and 105549/1), which provide third-party BS EN 442-2:2014 verification equivalent to the technical requirements of the UK building regulations pathway for heating products. The BSRIA route is the standard pathway used by manufacturers supplying the UK market post-Brexit.
credentials.isoText: ISO 9001:2015 (Certificate No. 0350124030591R2M) and ISO 14001:2015 (Certificate No. 0350124E2038902M), both issued 2024-06-10, valid through 2027-06-09. Issued by Xingyuan Certification Centre Co., Ltd. (CNAS-accredited, IAF member).
credentials.reachText: All CE-certified Jiuding products comply with REACH Regulation. SGS REACH/SVHC test report No. TSNEC2000446701 (2020-04-08) confirms no release of dangerous substances and is referenced in all 10 CE Declarations of Performance.
credentials.fireClassText: All CE-certified Jiuding radiators achieve reaction-to-fire class A1 (non-combustible) under EN 13501-1, as determined by VZLU TEST a.s. (Czech Republic), report P-VZLUTEST-068/23 (2023). Class A1 is required in many commercial and public-sector projects in Europe.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Common questions from distributors, contractors, and B2B buyers about Jiuding radiators.
faq.q1: How do I choose the right radiator height for my room?
faq.a1: Radiator height is determined by available wall space below the window — standard installations leave 100–150 mm clearance to the floor and 50 mm to the window sill. Heights from 300 mm to 900 mm suit most residential windows. Taller models (600–900 mm) deliver more heat output per section without requiring a longer unit, making them ideal for rooms with limited wall width.
faq.q2: How do I choose the right radiator length (number of sections or panel width)?
faq.a2: Length is selected to match the required heat output for your room. Calculate the room's heat loss (W) based on floor area, insulation, and climate, then match it to the radiator's rated output at your system's design temperature differential (ΔT). Jiuding steel panel and column radiators are rated to EN 442-2:2014, giving buyers verified output figures at standard ΔT50K and ΔT60K conditions.
faq.q3: What is the difference between a steel panel radiator and a multi-column radiator?
faq.a3: Steel panel radiators (types 11, 21, 22, 33) use pressed-steel panels with convector fins for fast, efficient heat-up — typically 15–20 minutes. Multi-column radiators (JDDH series, 50×25 mm or 70×15 mm profiles) use a traditional column-fin structure suited to higher flow rates and decorative applications. Both are made from carbon steel with electrophoretic coating and are CE-certified to EN 442-1:2014.
faq.q4: Which radiator type suits a central heating system with high working pressure?
faq.a4: Jiuding steel panel radiators (types 11/21/22/33) and the JDDH D/S 5025 column series are rated to a maximum operating pressure (MOP) of 1,000 kPa (10 bar). The JDDH 7015 column series and JDWY towel radiators are rated to 350–400 kPa. All products are tested to 1.3× MOP without leakage, as verified in CE Declaration of Performance reports issued by HEATEST s.r.o. (NB 2693).
faq.q5: How do I size a radiator for a room with large windows or poor insulation?
faq.a5: Large windows and poor insulation increase a room's heat loss, requiring a radiator with higher output. The standard approach: calculate total heat loss in watts (W/m² loss × floor area), then add 10–20% buffer. Jiuding offers 600+ specifications across 6 product series, so a matching output level is available for most residential and commercial applications without resorting to non-standard sizes.
faq.q6: Do your radiators work with low-temperature heating systems (underfloor heating pumps or heat pumps)?
faq.a6: Yes. Jiuding steel panel radiators are designed for hydronic central heating systems operating at supply temperatures from 45 °C to 90 °C. EN 442-2:2014 thermal performance data — independently verified in BSRIA reports 104719/1 and 105549/1 — provides output figures at multiple temperature differentials (ΔT30K, ΔT50K, ΔT60K), allowing accurate sizing for heat-pump-compatible low-temperature systems.
faq.q7: Can I use your radiators with an open (non-pressurised) heating system?
faq.a7: Column radiators rated to 350–400 kPa (JDDH 7015 series, JDWY towel models) are suitable for open or gravity-fed systems typically operating at 50–150 kPa. Steel panel radiators and JDDH 5025 column radiators rated to 1,000 kPa are over-specified for open systems but are fully compatible. Always verify the system's water pH (recommended 7–9) to prevent internal corrosion of steel components.
faq.q8: What CE certifications do Jiuding radiators hold, and what are the certificate numbers?
faq.a8: Jiuding holds 10 CE Declarations of Performance under EU Regulation No. 305/2011 (Construction Products Regulation), assessed by HEATEST s.r.o. (Notified Body NB 2693, Czech Republic) to EN 442-1:2014, AVCP System 3. Certificate numbers: 2693-CPR-0019 to 0024-2023 (column and towel radiators) and 2693-CPR-0010 to 0013-2024 (steel panel types 11/21/22/33). Full DoP documents are available on request.
faq.q9: Are Jiuding radiators compliant with UK building regulations after Brexit?
faq.a9: Yes. Jiuding's column radiators have been independently tested by BSRIA Limited (Bracknell, UK) to BS EN 442-2:2014, the UK-retained standard for radiator thermal performance. BSRIA report nos. 104719/1 (March 2023, covering 4 column models) and 105549/1 (December 2023, covering 3 column models) provide the third-party UK conformity evidence required by UK building regulations. BSRIA is the recognised independent test body for this pathway.
faq.q10: What does EN 442 certification mean, and why does it matter for buyers?
faq.a10: EN 442 is the European (and UK-retained) standard covering requirements and testing for steel, cast iron, and aluminium radiators used in water-based central heating systems. EN 442-1 defines dimensional and safety requirements (working pressure, surface temperature, coating); EN 442-2 defines the standardised thermal output test method. A CE Declaration of Performance under EN 442-1 means an independent notified body has verified the product meets these criteria — it is legally required for sale in EU member states.
faq.q11: Do Jiuding products comply with REACH regulation on hazardous substances?
faq.a11: Yes. All CE-certified Jiuding products have been tested for SVHC (Substances of Very High Concern) under the REACH Regulation. The SGS REACH/SVHC test report (No. TSNEC2000446701, issued 2020-04-08) is cited in all 10 CE Declaration of Performance documents and confirms no release of dangerous substances. This report is referenced by notified body HEATEST s.r.o. as part of the CPR technical assessment file.
faq.q12: What is the fire reaction classification of Jiuding radiators?
faq.a12: All CE-certified Jiuding radiators — column, panel, and towel models — achieve reaction-to-fire class A1 (non-combustible), as determined by VZLU TEST a.s. (Czech Republic) in report P-VZLUTEST-068/23 (2023). A1 is the highest classification under EN 13501-1 and is a requirement in many commercial, public-sector, and high-rise residential building projects in Europe.
faq.a13: Yes. Jiuding holds ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System certification (Certificate No. 0350124030591R2M) and ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management System certification (Certificate No. 0350124E2038902M), both issued by Xingyuan Certification Centre Co., Ltd. (Beijing), a CNAS-accredited, IAF-member certification body. Both certificates were issued 2024-06-10 and are valid through 2027-06-09. Scope covers manufacture and service of steel panel and column radiators at the Tianjin facility.
faq.q14: Are Jiuding products certified for the Russian market?
faq.a14: Yes. Jiuding steel panel radiators (types 11/21/22/33) and JDDH column series are certified to Russian GOST standards (GOST R), assessed against ГОСТ 31311-2022 and EN 442-1/2. Russia and the wider CIS region have been primary export markets for Jiuding since the company was founded in 2002.
faq.q15: What product series does Jiuding manufacture, and how many specifications are available?
faq.a15: Jiuding manufactures 6 product series covering over 600 specifications: steel panel radiators (types 11, 21, 22, 33), multi-column radiators (JDDH D and S series in 50×25 mm and 70×15 mm profiles), and towel radiators (JDWY series). Heights range from 300 mm to 1,800 mm; widths from 400 mm to 3,000 mm depending on series. Both standard and custom dimensions are available for OEM/ODM orders.
faq.q16: What is the working pressure and test pressure of your steel panel radiators?
faq.a16: Jiuding steel panel radiators (types 11/21/22/33) and JDDH 5025 column models have a maximum operating pressure (MOP) of 1,000 kPa (10 bar) and are pressure-tested at 1,300 kPa (13 bar, 1.3× MOP) without leakage, as required by EN 442-1:2014. The JDDH 7015 column series is rated to 350 kPa MOP; JDWY towel models to 350–1,000 kPa depending on model.
faq.q17: What is the maximum surface temperature, and is the product safe for spaces with children?
faq.a17: The maximum surface temperature of all CE-certified Jiuding radiators is 100 °C (measured at standard test conditions per EN 442-1:2014). At typical residential operating temperatures (60–70 °C supply), surface temperatures are significantly lower. For environments with children, Jiuding recommends pairing with TRV (thermostatic radiator valve) controls and optional decorative radiator covers, both of which are compatible with all panel and column models.
faq.q18: What coating process do Jiuding radiators use, and how durable is it?
faq.a18: Jiuding steel panel and column radiators use electrophoretic (e-coat) primer followed by a polyester powder topcoat. Coating adhesion tests to ISO 2409:2013 achieve a result of 1c–0 (highest adhesion class), as documented in all CE Declaration of Performance reports. Corrosion resistance is confirmed by 100-hour humidity testing per EN 442-1:2014 with no corrosion observed. Standard finish is white (RAL 9016); grey and black are available on request.
faq.q19: What is the maximum water temperature for Jiuding radiators?
faq.a19: All CE-certified Jiuding radiators are tested at inlet water temperature of 100 °C per EN 442-1:2014, and are designed for standard district heating and central heating systems operating between 60 °C and 90 °C supply temperature. For systems operating above 90 °C, confirm compatibility with the specific model's MOP rating and consult Jiuding's technical team for appropriate valve and fitting specifications.
